doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 纺织工业是我国国民经济的传统支柱产业和重要的民生产业
quote_en: The textile industry is a traditional pillar of the national economy and an important livelihood industry.
notes: Headline of a dedicated plan: stabilise markets, technical upgrading, brand building, M&A, tax rebates. Restriction side recorded in separate rows (dyeing, cotton/wool spinning, chemical fibre); also 严防低水平产能的转移和扩张 and 纤维加工量过快增长的态势得到明显控制.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 淘汰75亿米高能耗、高水耗、技术水平低的印染能力
quote_en: Eliminate 7.5 billion metres of energy- and water-intensive, low-tech dyeing and finishing capacity.
notes: Also 制定并完善印染、粘胶行业准入条件，指导行业规范发展; promotes low-water dyeing technology.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加速淘汰棉纺、毛纺落后产能
quote_en: Accelerate elimination of backward cotton- and wool-spinning capacity.
notes: Specific obsolete equipment models listed in the policy section.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 淘汰230万吨化纤落后产能
quote_en: Eliminate 2.3 million tonnes of backward chemical-fibre capacity.
notes: Also limits viscose lines below 20,000 t/y and wet-spinning spandex/acrylic processes. Other side: 支持化纤技术改造; 化纤差别化率由36%提高到50%左右.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 高性能纤维及复合材料
concept_en: high-performance fibres and composites (carbon fibre, aramid)
quote_zh: 高新技术纤维和复合材料的产业化，总产量由目前的7万吨提高到14万吨
quote_en: Industrialise high-tech fibres and composites, doubling output from 70,000 to 140,000 tonnes.
notes: Quantitative target. Sentence starts 加速实现高性能碳纤维、芳纶…; also wind-turbine blades and aerospace preforms from high-performance fibre. L2 mapping is a judgement (carbon fibre may sit under either).

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快推进产业用纺织品新产品的开发和产业化
quote_en: Accelerate development and industrialisation of new technical-textile products.
notes: Targets: geotextile domestic share 20% -> 50%; filtration materials 20% -> 50%; medical textiles; standards for use in infrastructure.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快纺织机械技术装备自主化
quote_en: Accelerate the localisation of textile machinery and equipment.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 实施自主品牌建设工程
notes: Target: about 100 brand enterprises; own-brand export share to 20%.

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 延伸中西部地区缫丝、织绸产业链，提高企业加工水平
quote_en: Extend the reeling and silk-weaving chain in the central and western regions and raise processing levels.
notes: Also 重点巩固提高现有200个中西部地区蚕桑生产基地 and 50 silk firms of the 公司加农户 type. Sericulture itself is farming; coded here under textiles (silk).

doc_name: 纺织工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加大棉花、厂丝收购力度
quote_en: Step up purchases of cotton and raw silk.
notes: Price/farmer support via central reserves; agricultural side of the textile chain.
